listing.name: Chibi-Robo! Plug Into Adventure! — Chibi Robo PC (Armandpro12) (Armandpro12)
listing.summary: The project reports the title screen, new game and prologue with real-time sound for both regions. A complete playthrough, videos and setup on a clean system are unconfirmed. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA GGTE01 or PAL GGTP01 disc image.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow Setup.exe to build locally from your own disc for your user account. Preserve existing saves before setup.

warnings: The project reports the title screen, new game and prologue with real-time sound for both regions. A complete playthrough, videos and setup on a clean system are unconfirmed.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
